officialName: Casa Dianu (Muzeul Cărții și Exilului Românesc)
heightHints: Semi-basement + ground floor + attic (mansard) per Agerpres; OSM building:levels=2. Corner pavilions with fish-scale zinc domes/cupolas, central mansard roofs with cresting.
metalVisibleInPhotos: 01.jpg (2026, after restoration): natural titanium-zinc roofs clearly visible – fish-scale domes on the corner tower and the two pavilions, standing-seam mansards, zinc cresting/ornaments. 02.jpg (Aug 2019, before/at start of works) shows the old grey metal domes with the POR site board.
verificationNotes: Unique named building: Casa Dianu, historic monument LMI DJ-II-m-B-07926, built c.1906 for magistrate Dumitru 'Tache' Dianu, bought by Dolj County Council in 2013 and restored/consolidated with POR 2014-2020 funds (contract 2017) to house the Museum of the Book and Romanian Exile (cIMeC museum guide address: Str. 24 Ianuarie 4). OSM way 746340895 (historic=building, name 'Casa Dianu', 24 Ianuarie 4) used for footprint. Note: OSM also has an unrelated way 746406494 named 'Casa Dianu' at Str. Alexandru Ioan Cuza 6 (building=house) – not the museum.
